newsitem.title: USA: Friedman's Inc to pay $7.1 mln to end suit.
newsitem.headline: Friedman's Inc to pay $7.1 mln to end suit.

text.p: Friedman's Inc said Monday it will pay A.A. Friedman Inc 250,000 shares of its Class A Common Stock under an agreement concerning the use of the "Friedman Jewelers" trade name.

The company said and that A.A. Friedman will realize a minimum of $7,062,500 upon the sale of such shares during or prior to June 1999, and that prior to the sale of the shares, Friedman's Inc will make advance cash payments to A.A. Friedman over the next 10 months, through an escrow arrangement, to pre-fund the minimum sale proceeds.
Friedman's Inc shares traded at 16-15/16 early Monday morning.

Friedman's Inc said that it has also, under the agreement, acquired all the rights of A.A. Friedman, based in Augusta, Ga., to use the "Friedman's Jewelers" tradename, and that the two companies have agreed to dismiss their litigation over the rights to the name.
Meanwhle A.A. Friedman will change its corporate name and the name of 110 stores from "Friedman's Jewelers" to "Marks & Morgan" by no later than September 30.
